copy.tagline: 将应用部署到 Vercel 并管理项目配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将前端应用部署到 Vercel 平台
copy.tagline_en: Deploy apps to Vercel and manage project settings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently deploy frontend apps to Vercel

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 能使用 Vercel CLI 部署 Web 应用到 Vercel，管理项目、域名和环境变量。它会自动处理身份验证，并在部署前检查本地构建、部署后验证 URL 是否正常，确认无误后才报告。
howto.when: 当用户要求部署、发布 Web 应用，或需要管理 Vercel 项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

say.text: 帮我部署这个项目到生产环境
列出我所有的 Vercel 项目

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can deploy web apps to Vercel using the Vercel CLI, manage projects, domains, and environment variables. It handles auth via OneCLI proxy, checks local build success before deploy, and verifies the live URL after deployment before reporting to the user.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or to manage Vercel projects, domains, or environment variables.

say_en.note: Claude runs vercel deploy --prod and verifies the result.
Claude runs vercel project ls and returns the list.
